name: xauusd_market
description: Read gold price and OHLCV candles from Yahoo Finance GC=F (COMEX gold futures proxy). IMPORTANT: NOT XAUUSD spot; always disclose this distinction and possible delayed quotes when answering. No API key; no orders. Reports source, quote timestamp/age, interval and futures volume. No funding or open interest.

interval.description: Yahoo candle interval; default 1h. Latest candle may be incomplete.

limit.description: Maximum usable candles to return; default 60. Market closures or missing bars may reduce count.
